sharedUi.contract: Shared failed-save UI retries flush() and discards through refresh(true).

contracts.disabled: The cross-server switch is disabled only when Trade configuration is offline. Saving is not a switch restriction.
contracts.saveTiming: The Trade callback edits with debounce=false and immediately flushes. A newer toggle during an active write remains in the draft and is written after the older acknowledgement.
contracts.fieldPreservation: The cross-server callback spreads the current Trade draft and changes only crossServerEnabled, preserving enabled, selectedItemIds and selectedCurrencyIds.
contracts.saveFailure: A failed switch save retains the dirty edited value. Retry flushes the retained draft; Discard refreshes the confirmed/server value.
